atoms.b: Indigenous people have strong ((++traditions arms)) and use their knowledge of the land they live on to support themselves. Nowadays, they are an important part of many ((++diverse divers)) towns and cities, maintaining their culture while also participating in modern, local life.

Nomadic indigenous people move from place to place, usually to find ((++food entertainment)) for their animals in areas with seasonal changes or dry ((++climates primates)). Examples include the Bedouin people in the Middle East and the Mongols of Mongolia.

Settled indigenous people have ((++permanent pretty)) settlements. They often live off the land through hunting, growing crops and keeping ((++livestock secrets)). They go to school and join in with everyday activities like everyone else, while also keeping their traditions ((++alive hidden)). Examples are the Maori of New Zealand and the Inuit peoples of North America.
